narr: A warm and anomalously moist airmass was in place across Mississippi ahead of a cold front. This front moved through the region early on the 3rd, with arctic air spilling south behind it. Ahead of the front, showers and thunderstorms developed, with some being severe and producing damaging winds. Given the high moisture content present, locally heavy rainfall occurred and resulted in localized flash flooding. Rainfall amounts of four to over five and a half inches fell in portions of the Pine Belt. Behind the front, some rain turned to freezing rain as temperatures dropped close to freezing. This resulted in light icing in portions of the Delta.
ev: Over two inches of rain fell in the Baxterville area, which lead to some flash flooding. Road flooding occurred on Highway 13 near Crown Zellerbach Road.
Multiple roads in and around Purvis had minor flooding.

Heavy rain fell across the Hattiesburg area. Storm totals around 4.7 to 5.7 inches fell across portions of the area. This resulted in instances of flash flooding across Hattiesburg. Flash flooding occurred on Annie Christie Lane and Collins Street in Hattiesburg, as well as on Chester Brown Road. Flooding occurred on Highway 49 and W 7th Avenue.
